description: 3.3 V microSD SPI breakout plus user-supplied FAT32 SDHC card (4–32 GB). Card must meet the 400 mA authored peak-current envelope; qualification is pending.

packages.name: MICROSD-SDIO-BREAKOUT
packages.notes: Assembled breakout module on 2.54 mm through-hole headers, at least 5 mm standoff. Check pin-1 orientation and underside clearance; keep microphone port/card access unobstructed. Bare chips are not interchangeable.
